sources: https://cityofulysses.com/parks/camping-frazier-park/ (City of Ulysses; the stored www URL redirects here; page modified 2026-04-13), read 2026-11-06: 'Camping at Frazier Park'; 'Reservations: No reservations are needed. If after hours, call for info. (620) 356-3097.'; 'Camping facilities include 6 stalls with water, electricity and sewer hook-ups — 2 with water & electricity, 1 with electricity only. They all include concrete pads, barbeque, and picnic table. Access to the playground and restroom facilities, shower located in east restroom by lake.'; 'A fee of $15 per recreational vehicle (R.V.) per night will be charged for the use of the utility hookups at Frazier Park. The time period for which the $15 covers shall expire at 12:00 pm the following day ... Please pay at the Ulysses Golf Pro Shop.'; 'Dumping of waste is prohibited'; Parks & Recreation, 1380 Frazier Park Rd, '(620) 353-1720'.

Esri World Imagery (37.56465,-101.33763 at 300 m and 37.5640,-101.3330 at 650 m), 2026-11-06: Frazier Lake is ~520 m long and 120-180 m wide (roughly 15-20 acres, well over the 5-acre line), east of the campground. The camping loop is on the park road west of the lake; its east end is ~40 m from the west shore, with the shore road and a tree line between.

values.note: No reservations; pay at the Ulysses golf pro shop (club house open 7 am-9 pm). After hours, call (620) 356-3097. The nightly fee runs to noon the next day.

summary: Confirmed FCFS (no reservations), water and sewer hookups, showers, $15 a night paid at the golf pro shop (page modified 2026-04-13). Cleared the 50 A amperage (from note/travelks; the city page gives none). Site count left at 6: the city's wording reads as either 6 or 9.
flags: Cleared hookups.electric 50: it came from note prose (inclusion_evidence cites 'City of Ulysses / travelks listing'), and the city's page says only 'electricity'. The sites do have electric.

The camping loop's east end is ~40 m from the west shore, but the shore road and a tree line are between, and I can't tell which pads are the hookup stalls, so I can't confirm a view. Lead: a lakeview call needs a ground photo of the stalls.
Rate $15 dated by the page's 2026-04-13 modification, read 2026-11-06. Fees left as recorded (same figure).
